notes: CardDemo's shared date check CSUTLDTC, CALLed by COTRN02C, CORPT00C and the CSUTLDPY copybook: it passes the date and picture to the Language Environment service CEEDAYS and returns a message (severity, message number, result, date, picture) in LS-RESULT, and the severity as RETURN-CODE. GnuCOBOL has no CEEDAYS: the COBOL side runs against tests/equivalence/le/ceedays.c, a model of IBM's documented behaviour for the pictures it models (YYYY-MM-DD and its '/' and '.' forms) -- every call here is one of those; each `why` cites the rule. CardDemo's callers also pass 'YYYYMMDD' in the 10-byte field, which that model does not cover (how CEEDAYS treats the trailing blanks is not modelled), so no call here uses it; nor a month outside 1-12, whose condition (2508 or 2517) IBM's documentation does not settle.
